name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon project within the Walker Lane gold trend of Nevada, approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty on the project and is earning up to a 50% interest by funding US$5 million in exploration expenses over three years. In 2026, Nevada Canyon commenced a reverse circulation drill program targeting resource expansion and deeper intrusive-related gold mineralization.
